entries.name: SRSD384
entries.stage: Sponsor-reported first participant dosed in Phase 1/2a; registry still not yet recruiting
entries.summary: SRSD384 is an investigational subcutaneous GalNAc-conjugated siRNA targeting INHBE. Sirius reported on 1 July 2026 that the first participant had been dosed in a two-part Phase 1/2a study in Australia. Part A studies SRSD384 alone in people with overweight or obesity; Part B studies SRSD384 with tirzepatide in participants who also have type 2 diabetes. The sponsor-submitted registry record still says not yet recruiting, has an estimated June 2026 start and 78 estimated participants, and has no posted results.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for SRSD384 or its investigational combination with tirzepatide.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed research evidence.
entries.supply: Research in Australia does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The sponsor's 1 July first-participant statement conflicts with the registry's older not-yet-recruiting status, last updated 5 June 2026; both dated accounts are retained and the registry is not silently treated as current recruitment evidence. The October 2027 completion and 78-participant enrolment remain estimates. The trial evaluates safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics and has no posted results. Fat reduction, lean-mass preservation and cardiometabolic benefit are development aims informed by genetics and preclinical work, not demonstrated human outcomes. Part B is investigational combination research, not evidence of added benefit, safety, an authorised regimen, UK access or supply.
